schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Uchha Shiksha Chhatravriti Yojana
schemes.eligibility: Minimum 60% marks in Class 12 board exams, family annual income below INR 2.5 Lakhs.
schemes.benefits: INR 500 per month (up to INR 5,000 annually) for up to 5 years.

schemes.name: Devnarayan Chhatra Scooty Vitran Evam Protsahan Rashi Yojana
schemes.target_group: Girl students from Most Backward Classes (MBC)
schemes.eligibility: Girls passing Class 12 with at least 50% marks enrolled in state degree colleges.
schemes.benefits: Free motorized scooty or annual incentive payment up to graduation/post-graduation.

schemes.name: Rajasthan Free Tablet Yojana (Shiksha Vibhag)
schemes.eligibility: Top merit rank holders in Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education (RBSE).
schemes.benefits: Free Smart Tablet with 3 years of complimentary internet connectivity.
schemes.application_portal: Direct departmental allocation via school headmaster/principal.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Anuprati Coaching Yojana
schemes.target_group: Competitive exam aspirants (UPSC, RPSC, REET, NEET, JEE)
schemes.eligibility: Annual family income under INR 8 Lakhs, domicile of Rajasthan.
schemes.benefits: 100% free professional coaching at reputed empanelled institutes plus INR 40,000 annual residential allowance for outstation candidates.

schemes.name: Gargi Puraskar Yojana
schemes.eligibility: Girls securing 75% or higher in RBSE board examinations continuing further studies.
schemes.benefits: Financial incentive of INR 3,000 to INR 5,000 along with a Certificate of Merit on Basant Panchami.

schemes.name: RTE Rajasthan Free Private School Admission
schemes.eligibility: Family annual income below INR 2.5 Lakhs; child entering pre-primary or Class 1.
schemes.benefits: 25% mandatory reserved quota for free elementary education in private recognized schools from Class 1 to Class 8.
